page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Normande?

Charlotte Normande is the 38th daughter and the 82nd child of the Charlotte Family. She is a dosundada, a hybrid between a human and a dwarf.

Normande is a very small girl with fair skin, purple eyes, and brown hair with yellow flowers in it. She wears a blue dress and has large, fairy-like wings. Like dwarves, she has a tail and her dress extends to cover most of it.

Not much is known about Normande's personality, but she enjoys playing with butterflies. She also appears to have a close relationship with her brother Charlotte De-Chat, as he allowed her to play on his hand.

Normande was seen playing with butterflies when Charlotte Linlin was heading to meet the Vinsmoke Family.
